Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your response; our team will provide the requested cost breakdown separately. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Please note that due to strict group directives, price reductions are frozen until December 2027, meaning our price of €438.21 is firm. Our Angebot stands at a price of €438.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

While we cannot move on price, we are open to discussing adjustments to the contract duration or volume if that would assist your planning. For your information, material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
